rules.source: QNC_v5/.cursor/rules/qnc-story-segment-timeline.mdc (the rule wins over the v5 code)
rules.story_parts: TON/OFF segments (kind tonovi | offovi) in sort_index order; the program is their sum; delete sets active = 0
rules.story_markers: one locked program_start at frame 0 and one locked program_end at the program length; segment borders are no markers; a user M marker keeps origin_part_id
rules.story_marker_slots: recomputed after every story change, one slot between every two adjacent markers; slot_id = start_marker_id|end_marker_id
rules.story_covers: a cover is bound to slot_id; deleting a marker (by the user or with its segment) deletes its slots and their covers; any other change keeps the cover on the same marker pair with the new frames, else on the slot keeping its start marker (a new marker split it: trimmed)
